integrity: Finite exact minor certificate table and self-contained rational verifier were checked against all admissible three-stratum size patterns through five parties and a two-lottery six-party witness; external independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only instances with exactly three distinct integer lower-quota strata and strict within-stratum residue order; only exact quota-respecting proportional lotteries, uniqueness conditional on feasibility, and no claim on the multi-stratum larger-size classification.
title: A sharp six-party boundary for uniqueness of envy-free proportional quota lotteries
